subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan — Acme (latency/cost targets & model shortlist)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP: technical evaluation (next steps)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for taking the time today — helpful discussion. Quick recap and my suggested next steps so we have an actionable MAP milestone for the technical evaluation:

1) Goal (what success looks like)
- Latency: p50 < 120 ms, p95 < 350 ms for 1k token average prompt length under expected concurrency (20 rps)
- Cost: target inferencing cost <= $0.004 per 1k input tokens (including caching amortization)
- Quality: automated pass rate on your eval set >= 92% (precision-oriented metric we discussed) and no critical hallucinations in top-10 samples

2) Model shortlist (initial candidates to benchmark)
- Mistral-Instruct-7B (float16 / q4_0)
- Llama 2 - 70B (int8 quantized variant)
- MPT-30B-instruct (float16)
- Redwood-curated open variant (redwood/rl-instruct-v1-lite) — fallback for lower latency targets

3) Tests & deliverables
- Latency/throughput sweep (p50/p95/p99) across sequence lengths 128/512/1024
- Token-cost estimation report (tokenization-level cost + batching impact)
- Functional correctness evaluation on ACME-provided eval set (and a small adversarial subset)
- Shortlist recommendation and final model selection recommendation with tradeoffs

4) Responsibilities (proposal)
- Acme: provide eval dataset (sample of 500–1,000 prompts), expected concurrency profile, and test accounts
- Redwood (Camila): coordinate runs, provide benchmark config and baseline runs
- Redwood (Neha): run infra/throughput tests and produce artifact logs
- Redwood (Marissa): commercial touchpoint, coordinate procurement/contract if committed

5) Dependencies & timeline
- Dependency: shared API keys + access to sample dataset by 3/24
- Draft benchmark completion by 4/02
- Internal review and selection by 4/08
- Target close for MAP milestone: 4/10

Attached is a quick MAP draft and a short benchmark spec (latency_benchmark_spec.pdf) — this is intentionally lightweight so we can iterate. Can you confirm: (a) timeline looks OK, (b) Sarah/Tom will share the eval set and access, and (c) any extra acceptance criteria (e.g., KMS/encryption, residency) we should add?

Thanks — I can ramp up the benchmark config as soon as we have the dataset.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Camila —

Appreciate the clear recap and proposed MAP items. A few quick notes:

- Timeline: Acme is comfortable with the proposed timeline but would like target completion pushed to the week of 4/06–4/10 if possible; our internal review is tight so 4/10 final decision is good.
- Security/compliance: please add KMS-backed key handling and a requirement that logs do not contain PII — we will share a short compliance checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to the draft benchmark results.
